description: This file defines the implementation of the RippleHandler class, which manages WebSocket connections and sends session intent messages within the WPEFramework plugin for Ripple integration.

classes.name: RippleHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing WebSocket connections and sending session intent messages to Ripple.

methods.name: RippleHandler::RippleHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes member variables and logs creation.

methods.name: RippleHandler::initialize
methods.description: Initializes the WebSocket endpoint and sets the event handler.

methods.name: RippleHandler::terminate
methods.description: Cleans up the WebSocket endpoint and resets connection state.

methods.name: RippleHandler::sendIntent
methods.description: Constructs and sends a session intent message over WebSocket, returning success status.
